exception.rationale: The workflow reduces architecture-governance risk by keeping future-state work proposal-only, preserving missing rationale as unknown, requiring an external human approval artifact before decision recording, and refusing acceptance, history rewriting, or implementation. This exception supports experimental entry only: the committed behavior and routing suites are structurally validated, but no hosted/model baseline comparison, independently reviewed uplift, deterministic script comparison, or promotion evidence is claimed.
